paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: Evaluation of our models and LLaMA-3-8B-inst.
model_annotation: The chart titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks” illustrates benchmark scores for two models across multiple datasets/metrics using paired (grouped) vertical bars. The horizontal axis contains the categorical benchmark names (left to right: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), Chat-Arena-Hard) and is labeled “Dataset and Metrics,” with category labels rotated diagonally; no explicit sorting (e.g., ascending/descending) is indicated beyond this fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled “Score (%)” and uses a linear numeric scale with tick marks at regular 10-point intervals, spanning roughly from 0 up to about 80. Each category shows two adjacent bars corresponding to the legend “Model” in the upper right: LLaMA-3-8B-it in blue and Ours (Iterative RLHF) in orange; approximate values by category are GSM-8K at ~80 (blue) and ~80–81 (orange), MMLU at ~66 (blue) and ~65 (orange), HumanEval at ~62 (blue) and ~64 (orange), TruthfulQA at ~44 (blue) and ~60 (orange), ARC at ~59 (blue) and ~64 (orange), MBPP at ~61 (blue) and ~60 (orange), LC AlpacaEval-2 at ~23 (blue) and ~31 (orange), MT-Bench (×5) at ~41 (blue) and ~42 (orange), and Chat-Arena-Hard at ~20 (blue) and ~29 (orange). The bars are uniformly styled without visible annotations, outlines, or special emphasis beyond the color coding and grouping.
